blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Classroom construction strategy and allocations must be data-driven to be responsive to school needs and should be applied to areas facing the most severe shortages, Education Secretary Sonny Angara said in a statement on Thursday. He said this was in line with the commitment of the Department of Education (DepEd) to equity in infrastructure and a response to a report from the Second Congressional Commission on Education (Edcom 2) pointing to gaps in allocations for local government units (LGUs) with the highest estimated shortages based on initial 2026 allocations.
